usage:
require "openai"

client = Openai::Client.new(api_key: ENV["OPENAI_API_KEY"])

result = client.images.edits.create(images: [nil], prompt: "string", model: "string", mask: nil, n: 1, quality: "low", input_fidelity: "high", size: "auto", user: "string", output_format: "png", output_compression: 1, moderation: "low", background: "transparent", stream: false, partial_images: 1)
pp result
